scope: Full scope over the 8 synthetic_reference artifacts named in reviewed_ids: the project scope FB2-MAN-SCO-000001, the safety plan FB2-MAN-SPL-000001, the HSI design FB2-SYS-HSI-000001, and the five scenario fixtures FB2-SCN-MUT-000001..000002 and FB2-SCN-CHG-000001..000003. This is a complete review of these 8 artifacts and is not a sample. The remaining 18 mutation scenarios and the remaining scenario expectations are outside this record's scope and are explicitly not claimed to have been reviewed.

findings.description: The project scope, the safety plan and the HSI design each carry an empty source_refs array. For the scope and the safety plan this is defensible: both are planning artifacts whose content is a statement of intent about a hypothetical project, and inventing an anchor for them would be worse than having none. For the HSI design it is a genuine weakness: FB2-SYS-HSI-000001 does carry three source anchors (FB2-SRC-COD-000001, FB2-SRC-COD-000004, FB2-SRC-HW-000002), but it specifies electrical budgets, timing budgets, fault indications and interface signal levels in detail and cites no anchor for any of them individually. A reader cannot tell which stated budgets are derived from source and which are synthetic. Recorded as a provenance-granularity finding, not as an ungrounded artifact.
findings.evidence: FB2-MAN-SCO-000001 source_refs [], FB2-MAN-SPL-000001 source_refs [], both lifecycle_status 'baselined' with no provenance. FB2-SYS-HSI-000001 source_refs ['FB2-SRC-COD-000001', 'FB2-SRC-COD-000004', 'FB2-SRC-HW-000002'] at artifact level only; its interfaces, electrical_budgets, timing_budget and fault_indications blocks carry no per-item source_refs.

findings.description: The two mutation fixtures carried in the artifact index declare their expected detector, expected finding (with severity, category and description) and expected remediation inside the ingestible artifact itself, which is the answer-leakage pattern the master prompt warns against: expected labels belong in a separate evaluator manifest so a checker cannot pass by reading the answer. This is checked and recorded as an observation about corpus structure, not as a claim that the acceptance gate is compromised: the gate in corpus.py compares produced findings against expectations it derives from these records, and the records carry human_approval_status 'pending', production_authorized false and product_verification_credit false. Whether the separation the master prompt asks for is adequately implemented is a question for the corpus owner; this review does not resolve it and made no change.
findings.evidence: FB2-SCN-MUT-000001 carries expected_detector 'Traceability completeness checker (missing parent)', expected_finding {finding_id: FB2-FND-MUT-000001, severity: high, category: traceability, description: 'FSR FB2-SAF-FSR-000001 has no parent safety goal (missing refines link)'} and expected_remediation. FB2-SCN-MUT-000002 carries the equivalent fields for the invalid-link-type detector.

dispositions.action: Partially accepted. The empty provenance on the scope and the safety plan is correct for planning artifacts and needs no action. The artifact-level-only provenance on the HSI design is accepted as a real granularity weakness and is referred to the design owner. No artifact was edited; the design is outside this review's authoring scope.

Referred to the corpus owner as a structural question about where mutation expectations live. This review made no change to the scenario files, which are outside its write scope in any case, and did not weaken or alter any acceptance gate.

limitations: Automated AI review performed in a single agent session. It is not organizational independence, not human confirmation, and not a qualified-checker result (master-prompt clause 2.9).

Scope is 8 artifacts, named individually. The corpus holds 20 mutation scenarios and 3 change lifecycles; only 2 mutation fixtures and all 3 change-lifecycle fixtures reachable through the artifact index were reviewed here. The remaining 18 mutation scenarios were NOT reviewed and no claim is made about them.

Verification performed: (a) provenance field presence and granularity read in all three planning/design artifacts; (b) the HSI design searched for any reference to the security requirement set, which produced FB2-REV-FND-000111 in FB2-REV-000003 and is cross-referenced here; (c) expected-label placement inspected in both mutation fixtures; (d) policy fields checked. (b) and (d) were clean.
The HSI design's interface signals, timing budget and electrical budgets were NOT re-derived against the real hardware. No board, schematic or hardware file was opened.
The scenario fixtures were read only. docs/artifacts/scenarios/change-lifecycles/*.json were not modified by this review or by any part of this pass.
review_method: Field-level provenance inspection and a recursive substring search of the design artifact for cross-set references, plus structural inspection of the scenario fixtures for expectation placement.
